title: Mixed Green Julienne Salad
description: Mixed Green Julienne Salad is a refined Continental salad featuring crisp mixed greens, finely julienned vegetables, toasted pine nuts, and Parmesan shavings, lightly dressed with a classic vinaigrette. Fresh, colorful, and elegantly plated, it is perfect as a fine dining starter.

ingredients.title: For the Salad Base
items: Mesclun mix (young mixed greens: arugula, frisée, oak leaf, baby spinach, red chard) – 60 g
Belgian endive, thin julienne – 30 g
Carrots, fine julienne – 40 g
Cucumber, fine julienne (seeds removed) – 40 g
Red bell pepper, fine julienne – 30 g
Yellow bell pepper, fine julienne – 30 g
Radish, fine julienne – 20 g

ingredients.title: For Garnish & Accents
items: Parmesan shavings (or aged Manchego) – 30 g
Toasted pine nuts (or candied walnuts for variation) – 20 g
Microgreens (e.g., red amaranth or micro basil)
Edible flowers (optional)

ingredients.title: For the Continental Vinaigrette
items: Extra virgin olive oil (cold-pressed, fruity) – 40 ml
White wine vinegar (or champagne vinegar) – 15 ml
Dijon mustard – 1 tsp
Honey (or agave) – ½ tsp
Sea salt – a pinch
Freshly ground black pepper – a pinch

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Wash and pat dry all greens.
Julienne carrots, cucumber, peppers, radish, and endive into fine, uniform matchsticks.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Vinaigrette
steps: In a bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil, whisking continuously until emulsified.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Salad
steps: In a chilled stainless-steel bowl, lightly toss the mixed greens with the julienned vegetables.
Dress with just enough vinaigrette to coat evenly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plate Like Fine Dining
steps: Using a ring mold, neatly layer the salad in the center of a chilled white plate.
Sprinkle toasted pine nuts and Parmesan shavings over the top.
Garnish with microgreens and edible flowers if available.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Final Touch
steps: Drizzle a few decorative drops of vinaigrette around the plate.
Serve immediately while crisp and fresh.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a light appetizer or accompaniment.
Pair with grilled chicken, seafood, or roasted meats.
Enjoy with Sauvignon Blanc or Pinot Grigio, or sparkling water with citrus zest.

chefTips: Keep all vegetables uniformly julienned for a refined presentation.
Dress the salad just before serving to maintain freshness and crispness.
Use chilled plates for a professional restaurant-style presentation.
Finish with edible flowers and microgreens for an elegant fine dining touch.
